expectations.text: States that instructions to a model are not enforcement, regardless of wording or emphasis
expectations.evidence: "CLAUDE.md is a system-prompt instruction. It fails in predictable situations, none of which are fixed by louder text"

expectations.text: Redirects away from rewording CLAUDE.md as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: "Keep the CLAUDE.md lines — once, lowercase, with the why and the alternative" - presented as secondary, not primary solution

expectations.text: Recommends permission deny rules in settings.json with concrete syntax
Recommends a PreToolUse hook for cases that need logic rather than a pattern match
Explains that the deny message should say what to do instead, not merely refuse
expectations.evidence: "tells the model the correct move instead of just 'no'" and "A rule with an escape route gets followed more than a bare prohibition"

expectations.text: Recommends verifying the device actually fires rather than assuming it works
expectations.evidence: No mention of testing or verification; only offers to write the rules

expectations.text: Recommends committing the rules so they apply to the whole team, not just one machine
expectations.evidence: No mention of committing rules to the repository

expectations.text: Explains why repetition and capitals do not make an instruction reliable
expectations.evidence: "Caps/repetition fatigue — everything shouted reads as background noise; it doesn't raise priority, it just lowers signal"
